ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT made as of the  8 day of October, 2021, by and between 320 E. 176TH sTREET, LLC, a New York limited liability company having an office at 320 East 176h Street, Bronx, New York 10457 ("Owner"), and 1824 ANTHONY AVENUE LLC, a New York limited liability company, having an office at 5 West 37th Street, New York, New York 10018 ("Developer") (Owner and Developer are sometimes hereinafter collectively referred to as the “Parties"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, Owner is the owner in fee of certain land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, located in the Borough of Bronx, County of Bronx, City and State of New York, known as and by the street address 320 East 176th Street, Bronx, New York, as more particularly described in Schedule A annexed hereto and made a part hereof and known asBronx County Tax Block 2892, Lot 24 (the “Owner Land"; the buildings and improvements located thereon or which may be located thereon in the future are herein referred to as the “Owner Building"; and the Owner Land and the Owner Building are herein collectively referred to as the "OwnerParcel"); WHEREAS,Developer is the owner infee of certain land,with the buildings and improvements thereon, located in the Borough of Bronx, County of Bronx, City and State of New York, known as and by the street address 1824-1828 Anthony Avenue, Bronx, New York, as more particularly described in Schedule B annexed hereto and made a part hereof and known as Bronx County Tax Block 2892, Lots 16, 17 and 18 (the “Developer Land", said building and improvements, together with any future replacements thereof permitted in accordance with this Agreement, being herein collectively called the “Developer Building.” and the Developer Land and the Developer Building being herein collectively called the “Developer Parcel"); WHEREAs,Developer intends to construct one or more new buildings on all or a portion of the Developer Land (each, a“New Developer Building”), with a bulk that would be in excess of the bulk permitted to be constructed on Developer Land under the Zoning Resolution (as hereinafter defined), if the Developer Land was considered as a separate and independent zoning lot; WHEREAS, there are certain“Development Rights”(as hereinafter defined) appurtnenat to the Owner Land that are in excess of the “Retained Development Rights" (as hereinafter defined) and that are available for transfer in accordance with the Zoning Resolution (the“Excess Development Rights"); WHEREAS, Owner and Developer intend, pursuant to the simultaneous hereto conveyance of the Owner Parcel by Developer to Owner, make the “Subject Development Rights” (as hereinafter defined) available for utilization in connection with the construction of the NewDeveloperBuilding:

WHEREAS, the Parties hereto are simultaneously herewith executing a Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions (the“Declaration") in accordance with certain provisions set forth in a definition of the term “zoning lot” in Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution (as hereinafter defined) in order to create a single zoning lot comprised of the Owner Parcel and the Developer Parcel (such zoning lot, as the same may be enlarged in accordance with the Declaration and the terms of this Agreement, is herein referred to as the “"Merged Zoning Lot"), and as more particularly described on Schedule C annexed hereto and made a part hereof, and (i) such other agreements as are necessary to effectuate the intent of the parties in connection with this Agreement; WHEREAS, all “parties in interest" (as defined in the Zoning Resolution) to the Merged Zoning Lot as shown on the Zoning Lot Certification (the “Zoning Lot Certification"), annexed hereto as Exhibit 1, have joined in the Declaration or have waived their right to do so and have either executed this Agreement, or subordinated their interest in the Merged Zoning Lot thereto (the Declaration, Zoning Lot Certification and such other documents and agreements are herein collectively referred to as the ^Zoning Documents"); WHEREAS, the parties hereto wish to set forth certain agreements with respect to their rights and obligations in and to the Merged Zoning Lot and other matters; NOW THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual covenants and agreements contained herein, and for other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which are hereby conclusively acknowledged, the parties hereto hereby covenant and agree as follows: 1. Certain Definitions.As used herein: (a) 1mean any additional Development Rights (other than Bonus Rights) that may become available to the Combined Zoning Lot by adding Additional Parcels in accordance with this Agreement. (b)“"Additional Parcel” shall mean an additional parcel, other than the Owner Parcel or the Developer Parcel, brought into the Merged Zoning Lot by Developer, either directly or indirectly, and as further defined in Section 10 herein. Owner shall not have the right to enlarge the Merged Zoning Lot by adding an Additional Parcel, or by any other means.
